test_title: PYST 7: SSC CHSL 2024 - Reasoning (Held On: 02 Jul, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: If 24 August 1932 was a Wednesday, then what was the day of the week on 11 September 1943?
solution: Given: **24 August 1932** was Wednesday. Now, 1932 to 1943 = 11 Years (9 Ordinary Years and 2 Leap Years). And, In 11 Years = 2 Leap years(1936,1940) and 9 Ordinary Years. So, 2 Leap Years have 4 odd days, And, 9 Ordinary Years have 9 odd days. Total odd days = 4 + 9 = 13.
